LeXtudio.Wpf.Cli - WPF command line utility

Usage: dotnet wpflex [options] <command> [command-options]

Options:
  --json      Emit structured JSON output
  -v, --verbose  Enable verbose logging
  --dry-run   Show what would be done without making changes
  --ci        Run in CI-friendly non-interactive mode
  --help, -h  Show help information

Commands:
  doctor       Validate the WPF development environment
  version      Display CLI and environment version information
  new          Scaffold a new WPF app or library
  build        Build a WPF project with WPF-aware defaults
  run          Run a WPF application
  publish      Publish a WPF application for deployment
  package      Package WPF output artifacts
  diagnostics  Run WPF-specific diagnostics and validation
  env          Inspect installed SDKs and tooling
  devflow      Query a running WPF DevFlow agent and inspect runtime state
